doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: Playing with Manetta in 1905 and the Eddie Dawson band
summary: Professor Manetta is asked about 1905, remembers the band with Eddie Dawson, and George Bucket is hired after a player walks off.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Professor Maletter, when did you play with Mr. Humphrey? About what year do you remember? You played with some jobs I know with everyone here I guess.
We played with a guy in 1905.
1905? Only one round. Only one round.
Do you remember who else was in the band then? Well, Eddie Dawson. We had a bass player? Yeah, Eddie Dawson. Bracefella. Bracefella. Yeah, Bracefella. He and his dad.

And we had a bass player. And we had a bass player. Yeah, Eddie Dawson. Bracefella. Bracefella. Yeah, Bracefella. Bracefella. Bracefella. Yeah, Bracefella. He and his dad. And, uh, what was that when you got drunk? Is that the same place they called the entertainers later? The same building. I know. I know. I know.

What did you play, Fess? Huh? What instrument did you play? Violin? I played the piano there. Mm-hm. That's fine. That's fine. What did you play, Fess? What instrument did you play? Violin? I played the piano there.
That time. I went back there again and I played the violin.
Who's band was that? Do you remember whose job it was? Eddie Dawson. Oh, Eddie Dawson. We'll see him soon, very soon.
Yeah, I see him occasionally. He's still working too. Works for the bank. Works for the Whitney bank.
Willie got in the Humboldt one night. Dead with him ass. And he went out. He went off the job. Better come out. Walk across the street, they saw George. And they hired George. George Bucket.
He had a lot of fun in those days, too. That's what they had to do to remember.
That's what they had to remember. Black Peep.
